scripts.check: pnpm toolchain:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.check:all: pnpm check && pnpm benchmark && pnpm corpus:check
scripts.format: prettier --write "{apps,benchmarks,docs,packages,scripts,services,tests,tools}/**/*.{json,md,mts,ts}" "*.{json,mts,yaml,yml}" README.md && uv run ruff format services/depth-worker
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "{apps,benchmarks,docs,packages,scripts,services,tests,tools}/**/*.{json,md,mts,ts}" "*.{json,mts,yaml,yml}" README.md && uv run ruff format --check services/depth-worker
scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run ruff check services/depth-worker
